literal: Other than not looking with direct intent, she smiles like she who looked askance with one eye.
translation: Apart from avoiding a direct, intent gaze at me, she smiles as if looking askance with a side-glance from one of her eyes.
modern: என்னை நேராகக் குறிவைத்து நோக்காமல் இருப்பதைத் தவிர, அவள் ஒரு கண்ணால் ஓரக்கண்ணாகப் பார்ப்பவள் போலப் புன்னகைக்கிறாள்.
explanation: In this couplet, the hero describes the subtle signs of the heroine's love. She avoids staring at him directly to preserve her modesty and keep their love hidden from others. Instead, she casts a delicate side-glance with one eye and offers a gentle smile. This playful and restrained gaze communicates her deep affection without being overly obvious.
